agent.question: What kind of role do you want to create?
agent.question_description: Describe what it should do and excel at. AI will prepare its name, description, instructions, and Plugins.
agent.prompt_placeholder: For example: Create a product research assistant that can find sources, analyze competitors, and produce well-structured reports.

agent.description_placeholder: Introduce this Agent in one sentence

group.question: What kind of team do you want to assemble?
group.question_description: Describe the collaboration goal and division of work. AI will recommend members and prepare a collaboration plan.
group.prompt_placeholder: For example: Create a product research team to collect market data, analyze competitors, and jointly produce a research report.
group.agent_required: Create at least one Agent first
group.name: Name
group.goal_placeholder: Describe the team goal, member responsibilities, collaboration, and delivery requirements
